about: System Reference Document 5.2.1 (CC-BY-4.0, attribution in app/data/srd/README.md): hand-written recipes; the rest are read from its text by scripts/roll_audit.py

entries.name: Acid
entries.why: SRD 5.2 adventuring gear

rolls.name: Acid
rolls.note: DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus

entries.name: Alchemist's Fire
entries.why: SRD 5.2 adventuring gear; Burning deals 1d4 Fire at the start of each turn

rolls.name: Alchemist's Fire
rolls.note: DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus; on a failure it starts Burning
rolls.repeat: start of each of its turns while Burning

entries.name: Basic Poison
entries.why: SRD 5.2 adventuring gear

rolls.name: Basic Poison
rolls.note: Extra damage when the coated weapon or ammunition deals Piercing or Slashing damage

entries.name: Holy Water
entries.why: SRD 5.2 adventuring gear

rolls.name: Holy Water
rolls.note: Only a Fiend or an Undead takes it; DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus

entries.name: Hunting Trap
entries.why: SRD 5.2 adventuring gear

rolls.name: Hunting Trap
rolls.note: DC 13; on a failure its Speed is 0 until the start of its next turn

entries.name: Potion of Healing
entries.why: SRD 5.2 Potions of Healing table

entries.name: Potion of Healing (Greater)
entries.why: SRD 5.2 Potions of Healing table

entries.name: Potion of Healing (Superior)
entries.why: SRD 5.2 Potions of Healing table

entries.name: Potion of Healing (Supreme)
entries.why: SRD 5.2 Potions of Healing table

entries.name: Acid Arrow
entries.why: two moments: on the hit, and again at the end of the target's next turn; both upcast

rolls.name: On a hit
rolls.note: On a miss: half of this initial damage only

rolls.name: End of its next turn
rolls.repeat: end of the target's next turn, after a hit

entries.name: Alter Self
entries.why: Natural Weapons: your Unarmed Strike with the growth, using your spellcasting modifier

rolls.name: Natural Weapons
rolls.note: The damage type is the growth's (claws, fangs, horns or hooves)

entries.name: Animate Objects
entries.why: the objects attack with the Animated Object stat block's Slam, rolled from that block

entries.name: Arcane Hand
entries.why: two different damaging effects with different upcasting

rolls.name: Grasping Hand: crush
rolls.note: A Bonus Action while the hand grapples the target

entries.name: Arcane Sword
entries.why: damage 'equal to 4d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier'

rolls.name: Arcane Sword
rolls.repeat: Bonus Action on your later turns

entries.name: Bestow Curse
entries.why: the 1d8 is one of four curses you choose from, added when you damage the target

rolls.name: Curse: extra damage
rolls.note: Only with this curse: whenever you deal damage to the target with an attack roll or a spell

adds.name: Bless
adds.why: up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws while the caster concentrates

entries.name: Blink
entries.why: a plain d6 at the end of each of your turns

rolls.name: Blink roll
rolls.note: 4 to 6: you vanish to the Ethereal Plane

entries.name: Call Lightning
entries.why: a storm you control adds a die

rolls.name: Call Lightning
rolls.note: Outdoors in a storm you control: +1d10

entries.name: Chain Lightning
entries.why: up to four targets save at the same time, so the damage is rolled once for all (2024 rules, Saving Throws and Damage)

rolls.name: Chain Lightning
rolls.note: One roll for all four targets

entries.name: Chromatic Orb
entries.why: the leap is a new attack and a new damage roll

rolls.name: Chromatic Orb
rolls.note: Two or more d8s the same: the orb leaps to another target within 30 ft, with a new attack roll and a new damage roll (as many leaps as the slot level)

entries.name: Confusion
entries.why: the 1d10 behavior and 1d4 direction are rolled for the confused creature

entries.name: Conjure Celestial
entries.why: two effects, each named, and both upcast (the reader misses Searing Light's); checked against the 2024 Player's Handbook

entries.name: Conjure Elemental
entries.why: the Restrained target repeats the save each turn for less damage (checked against the 2024 Player's Handbook)

rolls.name: Conjure Elemental
rolls.note: The spirit's damage type; on a failure the target is also Restrained

rolls.name: Restrained target
rolls.repeat: start of each of the Restrained target's turns

entries.name: Conjure Fey
entries.why: damage 'equal to 3d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier'

entries.name: Contact Other Plane
entries.why: the damage is to you, if you fail your own DC 15 Intelligence save

rolls.name: If you fail your DC 15 Int save
rolls.note: You take this damage

entries.name: Control Weather
entries.why: 1d4 × 10 minutes is how long the change takes

entries.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
entries.why: the damage grows each turn the bead waits

rolls.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
rolls.note: +1d6 for each of your turns that ended before it exploded (add them with Add dice)

entries.name: Dissonant Whispers
entries.why: adds the note that a failed save spends the target's Reaction; checked against the 2024 Player's Handbook

rolls.name: Dissonant Whispers
rolls.note: On a failure it must use its Reaction to move away from you

entries.name: Divine Smite
entries.why: a Fiend or Undead adds a die; on a Critical Hit its dice double with the attack's

rolls.name: Divine Smite
rolls.note: +1d8 against a Fiend or an Undead. Added to a weapon hit: on a Critical Hit, roll it with the attack's damage (Add dice) so its dice double too

entries.after_hit: a hit with a melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

entries.name: Earthquake
entries.why: the fissures and their depth are the DM's rolls; the damage is for creatures near a collapsing structure

entries.name: Eldritch Blast
entries.why: a beam each: an attack roll per beam, more beams at character levels 5, 11 and 17 (named so the card and Table rolls say beams)

entries.name: Enlarge/Reduce
entries.why: the 1d4 changes the target's weapon damage; it isn't a save

rolls.name: Enlarged: extra damage
rolls.note: Added to an enlarged creature's weapon or Unarmed Strike hits. Reduce instead takes 1d4 from them (not below 1)

entries.name: False Life
entries.why: upcasting adds a flat 5

entries.name: Fire Shield
entries.why: a warm shield or a chill shield, not both

rolls.name: Warm shield
rolls.note: To a creature within 5 ft that hits you with a melee attack

rolls.name: Chill shield
rolls.note: To a creature within 5 ft that hits you with a melee attack

entries.name: Flame Blade
entries.why: damage 'equal to 3d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier'

entries.name: Flame Strike
entries.why: both damage types upcast

adds.name: Guidance
adds.why: add 1d4 to one ability check you choose before rolling (2024 PHB)

entries.name: Heroes' Feast
entries.why: the Hit Point maximum (and Hit Points) go up by 2d10

rolls.name: Hit Point maximum
rolls.note: Each creature's Hit Point maximum increases by this much, and it gains the same Hit Points

entries.name: Magic Missile
entries.why: each dart deals its own 1d4 + 1

rolls.name: Dart
rolls.note: Each dart is rolled on its own; aim them at one creature or several

entries.name: Prismatic Spray
entries.why: a d8 picks each target's ray; then that color's damage

rolls.name: Ray color (each target)
rolls.note: 1 red, 2 orange, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 blue, 6 indigo, 7 violet, 8 two rays (roll twice more)

entries.name: Prismatic Wall
entries.why: each layer a creature passes deals its own damage

entries.name: Reincarnate
entries.why: a table roll for the new body (the DM may choose instead)

entries.name: Resistance
entries.why: the 1d4 is rolled when the protected creature takes damage, to reduce it

entries.name: Searing Smite
entries.why: the later damage happens before the save, which only ends the spell

rolls.name: On the hit
rolls.note: Extra damage from the attack: on a Critical Hit, add it to the attack's damage (Add dice) so it doubles

rolls.name: Each of its turns
rolls.repeat: start of each of its turns
rolls.note: Then it makes a Con save; a success ends the spell

entries.name: Shillelagh
entries.why: it changes your Club or Quarterstaff instead of rolling its own damage
entries.note: The weapon uses your spellcasting modifier for attack and damage, with a d8 damage die (d10 at level 5, d12 at 11, 2d6 at 17)

entries.name: Sorcerous Burst
entries.why: an 8 lets you roll another d8, up to your spellcasting modifier in extra d8s

rolls.name: Sorcerous Burst
rolls.note: For each 8 you roll, you can add another d8 (Add dice), up to your spellcasting modifier in extra d8s

entries.name: Spike Growth
entries.why: the damage is for every 5 feet moved

rolls.name: Each 5 feet moved
rolls.note: For every 5 feet a creature travels in the area

entries.name: Spirit Guardians
entries.why: Radiant or Necrotic by your alignment, not both

rolls.name: Spirit Guardians
rolls.note: Radiant if you're good or neutral, Necrotic if you're evil
rolls.repeat: when it enters or ends its turn in the Emanation

entries.name: Spiritual Weapon
entries.why: damage 'equal to 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier'

rolls.name: Spiritual Weapon
rolls.repeat: Bonus Action on your later turns

entries.name: Storm of Vengeance
entries.why: a different effect each turn

entries.name: Teleport
entries.why: the GM rolls the outcome; this is the damage of a Mishap

rolls.name: Mishap
rolls.note: Each teleporting creature takes this on a Mishap

entries.name: Time Stop
entries.why: how many turns you take is a roll

entries.name: True Strike
entries.why: a weapon attack; extra Radiant damage only from level 5

rolls.name: Extra Radiant (level 5+)
rolls.note: Added to the weapon's damage on a hit; the attack and damage use your spellcasting modifier

entries.name: Tsunami
entries.why: a smaller save-or-take for later rounds, shrinking each round

rolls.name: Later rounds
rolls.note: 1d10 less on each later round

entries.name: Vampiric Touch
entries.why: you also regain half the damage

rolls.name: Vampiric Touch
rolls.note: You regain Hit Points equal to half the Necrotic damage dealt

entries.name: Vitriolic Sphere
entries.why: only the initial damage upcasts; the later damage follows a failed save

rolls.name: Vitriolic Sphere
rolls.note: A success takes half the initial damage only

rolls.name: End of its next turn
rolls.repeat: end of its next turn, after a failed save

entries.name: Wall of Fire
entries.why: the lingering damage has no save

rolls.name: Burning side
rolls.repeat: ends its turn within 10 ft of that side or in the wall, or enters it

entries.name: Wall of Ice
entries.why: the two damages upcast differently

rolls.name: Frigid air
rolls.repeat: first time on a turn a creature moves through it

entries.name: Wall of Thorns
entries.why: 'Both types of damage increase by 1d8'

rolls.name: Entering the wall
rolls.repeat: first time on a turn it enters, or ends its turn there

entries.name: Wish
entries.why: the stress damage is per level of each later spell; 2d4 days is a duration

rolls.name: Stress
rolls.note: You take 1d10 per level of each spell you cast until a Long Rest: add dice for higher levels
